start: Settings, Your gym, joined member with no open orders, online

'Leave gym' and 'Stay'

My membership, the offer, gym reminders, diet plans and hours gone from the phone

start: Leave with an order the desk has just made ready

user_sees: The question says the order is ready at the desk: collect it or ask the desk to cancel it before you leave
must_not: A Ready order cancelled by the leave

steps.action: Leave with an Ordered order while the internet drops
user_sees: 'Your order isn't cancelled yet' with 'Try again' and 'Not now'; still in the gym
must_not: The member out of the gym with an order still open at the desk

start: Leave with one open order, and leave when the gym cannot be reached

user_sees: 'You have 1 open order (₹<amount>). Leaving cancels it.' and the leave button
must_not: The order left open at the gym

user_sees: The join screen with a note that the gym will be told when the phone is online
must_not: The phone back in the gym on the next start

start: An invite link for another gym: 'Switch to <gym>'

must_not: A switch that cancels the order without asking
